kind.description: Kind is program for a program; absent for an LLM routine (llm).

path.description:
Path is its file: an LLM routine's .prompt file, a program's
description file (in the app's copy).

description.description: Description is what its file says it does.

model.description: Model is the routine's model as written in its file (empty: the backend's default).

schedule.description: Schedule is the cron schedule; absent for routines run only by hand.

scheduleText.description: ScheduleText is the schedule in plain words ("At 09:20, Monday through Friday").

effort.description:
Effort is the routine's effort setting ("default" leaves it to the
backend); empty for a program.

folder.description:
Folder is where its runs work (absent: a temporary folder; a
program's data folder); frontends can filter routines by it.

session.description:
Session is "save" when runs keep their agent CLI session, else
"discard"; empty for a program.

builtinTools.description: BuiltinTools are the agent CLI built-in tools its runs may use.

trusted.description:
Trusted is whether it may run for real (what it can reach is what I
trusted); Untrusted says why not.

agentModel.description:
AgentModel and AgentEffort are the model and effort as the configured
backend's agent CLI takes them (claude --model/--effort; codex --model and
model_reasoning_effort), worked out by the core so frontends never
translate; empty means the CLI's default.

next.description: Next is the next scheduled run (absent when disabled or manual-only).

trigger.description:
Trigger is what started the run: "schedule", "manual" or "backfill"
(empty in records from before triggers were recorded).

for.description: For is the time the run is for (the schedule slot, the backfilled day).

id.description: ID is the run's history ID (as `runs show` takes).

sessionId.description:
SessionID is the run's saved agent CLI session (routines with
session: save): set when the run starts if the app picks its ID, when
it ends if the CLI does (Backend says which CLI resumes it).

backend.description:
Backend is the model backend running it, or that ran it (llm.backend's
value), once it got as far as the model.

folder.description:
Folder is the folder the run worked in (where its session resumes
from), unless it was an empty temporary one.

deadline.description: Deadline is when a running run is stopped (its routine's timeout).

queuedAt.description: QueuedAt is when the run started waiting for its turn, if it had to.

lastRun.description: LastRun is the latest outcome from run status.

executable.description: Executable is the app's copy, the one that runs.

checksum.description: Checksum is the executable's SHA-256 (trust is keyed to it).

writes.description:
Writes is whether it can change anything: a dry run passes it
--dry-run; one that doesn't write runs as it is.

env.description: Env is the environment variable it's passed as.

items.description: ProgramSecret is a secret a program declares, and whether it's stored (`auth login <program>` stores it).

program.description: Program is a program's own: what runs and with what.

source.description:
Source is its file as written: an LLM routine's frontmatter and
prompt, a program's description file.

title: procauto routines show --json
description: RoutineDetail is `routines show --json`: a routine of either kind with its file's source.
